starMirror.name: Magic Mirror

rewards.message:
{Magic Mirror}

The Magic Mirror is weary of being asked who is fairest of all. You have come with more practical concerns, and after a brief exchange it reveals a hidden cache beneath the ground.

The mirror shows only your own reflection. Perhaps your power is not yet strong enough to command its magic. Return after reaching level 5.
